Scenario fixture: orientation-content-parity (RGAA 13.9.1)

Each target has a stable id of the form ocp_case_NN. RGAA 13.9.1 asks that the content stays the same in portrait and in landscape. An element that an orientation media query hides is asked about, whatever the orientation the scan runs in.

A. Hidden in one orientation (CANTTELL)

01 — CANTTELL: table hidden with display:none in portrait
Year2025
02 — CANTTELL: paragraph hidden with visibility:hidden in landscape

Opening hours: 9:00 to 17:00.

03 — CANTTELL: orientation query nested in @supports

Delivery is free from 50 euros.

B. Not hidden by an orientation query (NOT APPLICABLE)

04 — NOT APPLICABLE: hidden by a width media query

Only on wide screens.

05 — NOT APPLICABLE: orientation query changes the layout only
